description: JavaScript source code for the SuiteCRM Calendar module, defining the CAL object with functions for calendar UI interactions, event handling, and integration with fullCalendar and other components.

methods.name: CAL.destroy_ui
methods.description: Destroys resizable and draggable UI components for a given element ID.

methods.name: CAL.basic.remove
methods.description: Removes an item from the CAL.basic.items collection.

methods.name: CAL.basic.add
methods.description: Adds an item to the CAL.basic.items collection.

methods.name: CAL.init_edit_dialog
methods.description: Initializes the calendar edit dialog.

methods.name: CAL.open_edit_dialog
methods.description: Opens the calendar edit modal dialog.

methods.name: CAL.close_edit_dialog
methods.description: Closes the calendar edit dialog.

methods.name: CAL.remove_edit_dialog
methods.description: Removes the edit dialog element from DOM.

methods.name: CAL.reset_edit_dialog
methods.description: Resets the calendar edit dialog to default state.

methods.name: CAL.reset_repeat_form
methods.description: Resets the recurrence repeat form fields.

methods.name: CAL.select_tab
methods.description: Selects a specific tab in the calendar UI.

methods.name: CAL.fill_repeat_data
methods.description: Fills in repeat data in the form based on current settings.

methods.name: CAL.fill_repeat_tab
methods.description: Populates the repeat tab with data.

methods.name: CAL.repeat_type_selected
methods.description: Handles selection of repeat type and updates UI accordingly.

methods.name: CAL.GR_update_user
methods.description: Updates the focus group user list via AJAX.

methods.name: CAL.GR_update_focus
methods.description: Updates focus group focus based on record.

methods.name: CAL.toggle_settings
methods.description: Toggles the calendar settings modal.

methods.name: CAL.fill_invitees
methods.description: Fills invitee fields based on focus registry.

methods.name: CAL.repeat_type_selected
methods.description: Handles UI changes when a repeat type is selected.

methods.name: CAL.load_form
methods.description: Loads the calendar event form for creating or editing an event.

methods.name: CAL.full_form
methods.description: Submits the full form for editing.

methods.name: CAL.disable_buttons
methods.description: Disables action buttons in the calendar UI.

methods.name: CAL.enable_buttons
methods.description: Enables action buttons in the calendar UI.

methods.name: CAL.dialog_create
methods.description: Creates and opens a dialog for creating a new calendar event.

methods.name: CAL.dialog_save
methods.description: Saves the calendar event via AJAX and updates the calendar display.

methods.name: CAL.remove_all_recurrences
methods.description: Removes all recurrence instances of an event.

methods.name: CAL.dialog_remove
methods.description: Removes an event and its recurrences.

methods.name: CAL.refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the calendar events list.

methods.name: CAL.clear
methods.description: Clears all calendar items from the UI.

methods.name: CAL.show_additional_details
methods.description: Displays additional details for an event.

methods.name: CAL.clear_additional_details
methods.description: Clears cached additional details.

methods.name: CAL.toggle_shared_edit
methods.description: Toggles the shared user list modal.

methods.name: CAL.goto_date_call
methods.description: Navigates to a specific date based on input.

methods.name: CAL.check_forms
methods.description: Validates forms before submission.

methods.name: CAL.toURI
methods.description: Converts an object to URL-encoded query string.

methods.name: CAL.each
methods.description: Iterates over an object or array, executing a callback.

methods.name: CAL.contains
methods.description: Checks if an array contains a specific object.

methods.name: CAL.update_vcal
methods.description: Updates the user's vCalendar data via AJAX.
